title: Pantry estimator
lead: Compute per-item estimates from purchases, recipe consumption and shelf-life decay (N1).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** UI and nudges.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: This is the core of the waste-reduction goal, and it works without any manual input.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: None if the pantry interview is done.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. An event-sourced estimate: purchases, consumption from "made" meals, tap events.
2. Apply shelf-life decay per ADR 0023; compute an estimated quantity, expiry and confidence.
3. Recompute incrementally on new events.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Tests pass; estimates from real order history look plausible to the owner.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
